title: Cobblemon Clumpy Bros Modpack
description: Modpack used in the Clumpy Bros Cobblemon series! Fabric and NeoForge versions are available!
body:
![Clumpy Bros](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18687dd80feef348a9375afdcfb28892c8b76e73.png)
These are all of the mods used in the Clumpy Bros Cobblemon series! It includes almost all of the Pokemon thanks to AllTheMons x Mega Showdown, various addons such as Bloo's Gacha Machine and Cobbleworkers, QoL additions such as LambDynamicLights - Dynamic Lights and Quick Shulker Boxes, and much more!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Pv0Wdfd1VVA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This pack will continue to be updated as more episodes are released. You can choose between Fabric or NeoForge. NeoForge was included starting with Version 1.7.1e. Our series is made using a fabric modpack so you will see different mods in NeoForge. We recommend a minimum memory allocation of 4GB (4096MB). Enjoy!


<details>
<summary>Seen in Videos but Not Included in This Pack</summary>

### Mods/Packs

_NOTE: The following mods/packs may appear in videos, but are currently not included as they are used for video creation, may not be wanted by the average user, or are in development by us. This list does not include removed mods from old versions of this modpack. See the changlogs for that information:_

- Carpet
- Chunk loaders
- Cobblepastas [Cobblemon]
- Kilt (Used for adding NeoForge mods to Fabric)
- Pehkui
- ReplayMod
- Silence Mobs
- SlimyFloor (Only on Curseforge)
- Our mods in development (Space, Mega Lechonk, and a few others)
- Yes Steve Model

### Pokémon

_NOTE: The following Pokémon are not included in this modpack as of version 1.7.3e. They appear in videos due to these packs:_

- Complete Cobblemon Collection Myths and Legends Compat - (Seismitoad, Tympole, Palpitoad, and Ting-Lu)
- Planeta Cobblemon's Pokémon Pack - (Iron Boulder, Iron Jugulis, and Celesteela)
- E19 Cobblemon ONLY Minimap Icons - (Not on Modrinth)

</details>

<details>
<summary>FPS Drops or Hardware Limitations Click Here</summary>

- Try increasing your ram in settings. Click the gear icon located in the bottom left of your modrinth app. It is under the Synced settings tab. Scroll down and you will see a section labeled Memory allocation. Here you can input whatever ram your system can afford to use on the game.

## Disabled by default for performance reasons
- Complementary Shaders - Reimagined (Disabled by Default as of update 1.6.0)
  
- Distant Horizons (Disabled by Default as of update 1.0.3)
  - Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric) (Disabled by Default as of update 1.0.3)
  - NoisiumForked (Disabled by Default as of update 1.0.3 and removed as of 1.8.1)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Installation Instructions Click Here</summary>

Singleplayer (Only needed if you have a version that is before update 1.0.3. This is not needed if you have 1.0.3+):

- Once the modpack is installed on the Modrinth app click the ⋮ symbol in the top right of the screen on your installation of the modpack.
- There should be two options that show up. Click on Open Folder.
- Once the folder is open, double click on the folder labeled datapacks.
- The contents in the datapacks folder need to be copied and pasted into the save folder of your world. 
- Copy and paste the datapacks into the /saves/[WORLDNAME]/datapacks  ([WORLDNAME] will not be your world's name, this is an example).

Server:
- If you are hosting a server most mods and all datapacks need to be on the server.
  - If you are not sure how to do this we suggest looking up a tutorial.
- If you are using a public hosting site follow their instructions on how to install a modpack.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Having Issues? Click Here</summary>

## Worlds crashing due to: "Errors in currently selected datapacks prevented the world from loading" 

If your world if from our 1.7.3d modpack or prior and you have updated to a 1.7.3e or newer modpack version there is a good chance it is nothing datapack related. The issue is likely due to the Biome Replacer mod. This mod had an issue prior to their 3.0 version that messed up entries in the level.dat file. Luckily there is a fix and they provided a step by step guide to fix the issue. The link below will take you to their github. Follow their steps and your world should be fine. Make sure to make a backup so there is no chance of losing your world if you make a mistake.
https://github.com/WerDei/Biome-Replacer/blob/master/docs/RECOVERY-26.1.md

## Legendary Spawning Myths and Legends

**_NOTE: This mod is only on the 1.0.0-1.6.0 versions of the modpack Starting at 1.7.1 this mod is not installed._**

The items and spawns are a part of the Myths and Legends mod/datapack. For more information visit 0Skill Wiki.

Legendaries will not spawn when right clicking with the item: Ensure you are in the proper biome. If you are unsure of the biome it would spawn in when using the item go to the 0Skill Wiki.

## Other Issues

If you experience other issues feel free to report them in our discords issue reporting section or help and support section.
</details>
